AUTOMATIC TRANSAXLE DIAGNOSIS
TSB Revision
AUTOMATIC TRANSAXLE
23A-222
DIAGNOSIS
Required Special Tool:
MB991502: Scan Tool (MUT-II)
STEP 1. Using scan tool MB991502, read the A/T 
diagnostic trouble code.
CAUTION
To prevent damage to scan tool MB991502, always turn the 
ignition switch to "LOCK" (OFF) position before 
connecting or disconnecting scan tool MB991502.
(1) Connect scan tool MB991502 to the data link connector.
(2) Turn the ignition switch to the "ON" position.
(3) Read the A/T diagnostic trouble code.
(4) Turn the ignition switch to "LOCK" (OFF) position.
Q: Is A/T diagnostic trouble code numbers "22" or "23" 
output?
YES : Refer to P.23A-103, code number 22: Input Shaft 
Speed Sensor System, or refer to P.23A-115, code 
number 23: Output Shaft Speed Sensor System.
NO : Go to Step 2.
STEP 2. Using scan tool MB991502, check actuator test.
(1) Connect scan tool MB991502 to the data link connector.
(2) Turn the ignition switch to "ON" position.
(3) Set scan tool MB991502 to actuator test mode for following 
items.
a. item 01: Low-reverse Solenoid Valve
b. item 02: Underdrive Solenoid Valve
c. item 03: Second Solenoid Valve
d. item 04: Overdrive Solenoid Valve
• An operation sound should be heard from solenoid 
valve when solenoid valve is operated.
(4) Turn the ignition switch to "LOCK" (OFF) position.
Q: Is the solenoid valve operating properly?
YES : Go to Step 3.
NO : Replace the corresponding solenoid valve. Refer to 
GROUP 23B, Valve Body P.23B-69.
